acceptanceCriteria: The diagnostic branch is based on the latest default main observed at start; the hosted product test tree is a detached checkout of exact commit a1dbec70c8fc050b95165163da0da03cd90b79d1, with only the hash-pinned test instrumentation patch applied.
The branch contains exactly the two implementation files in scope; the diagnostic workflow is push-triggered only for codex/composition-diagnostic-* and has contents:read permissions.

The hosted job uses ubuntu-24.04 and the repository process-observer test runner; it runs the full cockpit-verification composition target at most three times, stops after the first failure, and uploads complete logs and actual attempt/state artifacts with if: always().
Hosted evidence binds the workflow SHA, exact a1db source SHA, patch SHA, command, each attempt ID, exit status, and artifact digests; three passes are reported only as hosted non-reproduction.
